title: The Retrieve-Rewrite-Answer Framework for KG Question Answering
summary: This community centers on the 2023 arXiv preprint 'Retrieve-Rewrite-Answer: A KG-to-Text Enhanced LLMs Framework for Knowledge Graph Question Answering.' The cluster consists of the paper itself and its seven authors, who collaborated to propose a method for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) in the context of Knowledge Graph (KG) question answering. The framework specifically utilizes a KG-to-Text approach to improve the retrieval and answering processes.
key_findings: The core entity is a 2023 arXiv preprint (arXiv:2309.11206) focused on Knowledge Graph Question Answering.
The proposed framework is named 'Retrieve-Rewrite-Answer' and is designed to enhance LLMs.
The methodology involves a 'KG-to-Text' enhancement strategy.
The paper was authored by a team of seven researchers: Yike Wu, Nan Hu, Sheng Bi, Guilin Qi, Jie Ren, Anhuan Xie, and Wei Song.
The work is categorized under the cs.CL (Computation and Language) subject area on arXiv.
The paper is cited in the context of other retrieval-augmented generation and knowledge graph modeling studies, such as those by Wu et al. (2024) and Xu et al. (2024).
